sections.title: Multi-Layered Defense Strategy
sections.body: The security of our infrastructure is approached with zero-trust methodology. Physically, our site in Kenya is located within a gated industrial park with triple-redundant perimeter fencing and 24/7 armed security patrols. Access to individual compute modules requires multi-factor biometric authentication (fingerprint and iris scan) and is logged in real-time. Digitally, we protect the management network from the public internet using enterprise-grade firewalls and intrusion detection systems (IDS). For our DePIN and Cloud clients, we ensure complete logical isolation of traffic through advanced VLAN tagging and hardware-level encryption. Every server rack is equipped with vibration and door-opening sensors, instantly alerting our NOC (Network Operations Center) of any unauthorized physical proximity. In an era of increasing digital and physical threats, Kenya AI Compute provides a sanctuary for the world's most valuable computational assets. sections.title: Security Features
items: Physical: Armed patrols, biometric access control, and 90-day CCTV retention.
Environmental: Automatic FM-200 gas fire suppression (electronics-safe).
Network: Automated DDoS protection and isolated management fabrics.
Monitoring: 24/7 NOC oversight with direct incident response protocols.
Auditing: Comprehensive access logs for all physical and logical entries.
